description: This file defines the OmicsClient class used for interacting with the Amazon Omics AWS service. It declares various methods corresponding to API operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, that enable managing Omics resources such as read sets, annotation stores, references, workflows, and more.

classes.name: OmicsClient
classes.description: A client class for the Amazon Omics service, providing methods to call AWS API operations related to genomic data management.
